name: Bead of Iron
body:
School abjuration; Level druid 6, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (an iron bead strung on an oxen-hide thong)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 minutes/level or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

While the bead is worn, you gain a +4 bonus to his AC and damage reduction of 10/adamantine. Once 10 points of damage per caster level have been prevented, the spell ends and the bead becomes a normal object again.
